subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should this issue retain only WhatsApp reaction query/history while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79996 owns passive events, or should one umbrella implementation cover both?
rationale: Current source proves all gaps, but lookup, durable history, passive hooks, and agent-visible events have different privacy, persistence, routing, and turn-trigger consequences that code inspection cannot choose.

options.title: Split query and events
options.body: Keep this issue for generic lookup/history and let the narrower hook issue own passive reaction add/remove events.

options.title: Use one umbrella
options.body: Make this issue canonical for query, persistence, passive hooks, and agent visibility, then supersede the narrower hook issue.

recommendation.title: Split query and events
recommendation.body: Keep this issue for generic lookup/history and let the narrower hook issue own passive reaction add/remove events.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail connects this person most directly to the current WhatsApp action-discovery surface and earlier reaction behavior.
